scripts.name: Setup Worktree
scripts.command: sh -c 'if command -v vp >/dev/null 2>&1; then vp i; else "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/node_modules/.bin/vp" i; fi' && ln -sf "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.env" .env && ln -sf "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/infra/relay/.env" infra/relay/.env && node apps/web/scripts/warm-dep-cache.ts

scripts.name: Setup Worktree (Windows)
scripts.command: $t3SetupVp = if (Get-Command vp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'vp' } else { "$env:T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT\node_modules\.bin\vp.cmd" }; & $t3SetupVp i && New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path .env -Target "$env:T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT\.env" -Force && New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path "infra\relay\.env" -Target "$env:T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT\infra\relay\.env" -Force && node apps\web\scripts\warm-dep-cache.ts
